role: agent completion, event verification, artifact capture, and downstream routing
phase_order: mark event processed and archive owned events

event_matching.declared_emits_missing: failed, diagnostic agent-error, no downstream launch; exception: core generation chains (chain metadata.coreGenerationChain) complete via the generation import backstop when the payload imports cleanly (7217baa)

routing.dedupe: skip target already running, complete, or completed
routing.loop_guard: repeat current-agent:event pair completes run to avoid infinite loop

event_artifact_triage.trigger: quality_gate_fail_chain invokes the triage helper on quality-gate failure (8622d7e)
event_artifact_triage.helper: web/scripts/event-artifact-quality-gate.cjs, best-effort node invocation (failure logged, never fatal)

invariants: never fabricate the declared emits event
diagnostic events never satisfy success handoff matching
a missing agent summary stubs as status unknown; an all-stub completed run resolves needs_review with decision_required, never complete (0c96b73)
archive only events owned by run id plus source or agent
quality gates run before generation import and downstream routing
fan-in launches exactly once under fan-group lock
fan-out launches detached with nohup/disown semantics
task status propagation happens on completed, failed, and stopped
